# Curtis Plumbing

Curtis Plumbing is a family-owned plumbing company in Sherman Oaks, California.
We have served Los Angeles and Ventura counties since 1939.
Our shop is at 13446 Ventura Boulevard, Sherman Oaks, CA 91423.
We do drain cleaning, water heaters, leak detection, sewer inspection and repair, toilets, faucets, disposals, gas, earthquake valves, and backflow.
We take residential, commercial, and industrial calls.
Our phone is (800) 729-8149 and we take emergency calls 24 hours a day, every day.
Our email is CurtisPlumbingSince1939@gmail.com.
Our licence is CA Lic #383946.
Call (800) 729-8149 for the fastest answer.
